dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge exhibits a deep concave spline, transitioning from a sharp posterior projection at the apex to a broad curve at the base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex is characterized by a rounded geometry with a medium pixel radius, lacking sharp terminal points.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The anterior margin maintains a consistent posterior slope of approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 1.2:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible white linear striations on the mid-dorsal flank and several small irregular nicks along the lower half of the trailing fin margin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density white punctate patterning and specular reflections concentrated along the lower lateral boundary of the visible torso.
